admin.title: Admin
admin.loadFailed: This could not be loaded. Try again.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.body: For FitMe staff only. Access is checked on the server for every action.
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the email and password.

denied.title: You do not have admin access
denied.body: {{email}} is not a FitMe admin, so you have been signed out of the admin area. Ask a super admin to add you.

stats.noRevenue: No verified payments yet. Revenue appears here once payments go live.

users.search: Search by email, phone, name or user ID
users.deactivateBody: The person is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in or use the app until reactivated. Their data is kept.
users.reactivateBody: The person can sign in and use FitMe again.
users.noPhoneSteps: Phone step counting not set up

pricing.accessBody: Welcome Unlock comes first, then the free trial, then the free plan unless the user subscribes. Dates count from sign-up.
pricing.applyExisting: Also apply to people who are still in a free stage (recalculated from their sign-up date). Leave off to change new sign-ups only.
pricing.accessConfirmNew: New sign-ups get these stages. Existing users keep theirs.
pricing.accessConfirmExisting: New sign-ups and everyone still in a free stage get these stages, counted from their sign-up date.
pricing.pricesBody: Monthly prices per market. Period totals and discounts are calculated from these.
pricing.roundDown: Always down (saving never less than shown)
pricing.offerEndsHint: Leave empty to show no regular price struck through.
pricing.lowest30d: Lowest price in the last 30 days
pricing.safety: Saving prices never changes existing subscriptions or payment records. Every version is kept.
pricing.pricesConfirmBody: The Plans screen shows the new prices straight away. Existing subscribers are not affected.
pricing.plansBody: Names, descriptions and benefits shown on the Plans screen, and whether a plan is offered.
pricing.offered: Offer this plan to new subscribers
pricing.blankDefault: Leave empty to use the app's default text.

testimonials.noteHint: Required when you request changes. Shown to the author.
testimonials.featured: Feature at the top of Stories
testimonials.notReviewable: This testimonial can no longer be reviewed.

content.textsHint: Empty fields use the app's built-in text for that language.
content.showStories: Show published stories in the app
content.bannersHint: Short messages at the top of Home. Inactive or ended banners are not shown.
content.linkHint: An app path such as /plans, or a full https address.
content.ribbonsHint: A short message across the top of the app. The newest active one is shown.
content.homeSectionsHint: Order and show or hide the sections on the member Home screen.

features.safety: Turning a feature off hides it and the server refuses it. No user data is deleted; turning it on again restores everything.

photoScan.title: Food photo scan
photoScan.body: Scan a meal with the camera.

aiEstimate.title: AI food estimate
aiEstimate.body: Estimate foods that are not in the database.

upgradePrompt.title: Upgrade prompt
upgradePrompt.body: The gentle prompt for free users on Home.

cloudWearables.title: Cloud watches (Garmin, Oura, WHOOP ...)
cloudWearables.body: Needs the Open Wearables backend. Keep off until it is deployed.

routeTracking.title: GPS route tracking
routeTracking.body: Track walks, runs and rides with a map.

contact.title: Contact form
contact.body: Members can message support from Help.

diagnostics.title: Send diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Members can send a technical report from Settings.

foods.saved: Food saved. Search shows it within five minutes.
foods.suggestionsHint: Foods users saved from an AI estimate. Check the values, then add them to the shared database or reject them.

settings.androidUrlHint: Shown on the web once set.
settings.iosUrlHint: Shown on the web once set.
settings.invalid: Check the links: they must be full https addresses.
settings.maintenanceOn: Show a maintenance notice instead of the app
settings.maintenanceHint: Staff can still open the admin dashboard.
settings.minAppVersionHint: Phone apps older than this must update first (for example 1.2.0). Empty means no minimum.

admins.passwordFailed: Password not changed. Check the current password.
admins.googleManaged: You sign in with Google. Manage your password and two-step verification in your Google account.
admins.sessionsRevoked: All your sessions end within an hour; this one ends now.
admins.teamHint: Moderators review testimonials. Admins also manage users, prices, content, features and foods. Super admins also manage the team.
admins.onlySuper: Only super admins can change the team.
admins.removeBody: {{email}} loses admin access. Their FitMe account stays.
admins.addHint: The person must have a FitMe account.
admins.lastSuper: There must be at least one super admin.
admins.notFound: No FitMe account with that email.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Real counts from the database. Change the range or pick a country.
analytics.noRevenue: No verified payments in this range.

coupons.subtitle: Discount codes per country, plan and period. Codes are never deleted, only switched off.
coupons.storeNote: Web (Cashfree) payments use these codes directly. For the App Store and Google Play, create matching offer codes in the store consoles.

finance.subtitle: Prices per country, payments, receipts and payment gateway logs.
finance.paymentsBody: Verified payments from the stores and Cashfree. Records are never edited; refunds change only the status.
finance.noPaymentsBody: Payments appear here once the stores or Cashfree send them.
finance.webhooksBody: Every call from RevenueCat and Cashfree, and whether it changed a plan.
finance.storeNote: Web prices apply immediately. App Store and Google Play prices must also be set in the store consoles (see docs/store/pricing.md).

integrations.subtitle: Keys are stored in Google Secret Manager. They are never shown again after saving.

hints.GEMINI_API_KEY: Used for food photo scan, AI estimates and the coaches.
hints.CASHFREE_CLIENT_ID: From the Cashfree dashboard, Developers, API keys.
hints.CASHFREE_CLIENT_SECRET: Also used to check Cashfree webhook signatures.
hints.REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH: The authorization header you set on the RevenueCat webhook.
hints.REVENUECAT_SECRET_KEY: RevenueCat project settings, API keys, secret key.
hints.OPEN_WEARABLES_API_KEY: Only needed once the Open Wearables backend is deployed.

media.title: Media library
media.body: Images for banners, pages and onboarding. Uploads are compressed.
media.failed: That did not work. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image under 5 MB.
media.emptyBody: Upload an image to use it in banners and pages.

notify.sendBody: Goes to the in-app inbox and as a push message to phones that allowed notifications.
notify.title: Title
notify.pushNote: Push messages reach the Android and iOS apps. On the web, members see the message in the inbox.
notify.announcementsBody: A message on the Home screen for chosen countries and plans, between two dates.

pages.body: FAQ, help articles, terms, privacy and tips. Published pages are at /p/<slug> and in Help.
pages.title: Title
pages.bodyHint: Blank line = new paragraph. Start a line with # for a heading or - for a list.

plans.freeLaunchBody: Makes every feature free for everyone, or only in chosen countries. Plans, prices and subscriptions are kept; turning it off brings the Welcome Unlock, trial and paid plans back at once.
plans.freeLaunchConfirmOnBody: Every feature becomes free for the selected members straight away.
plans.freeLaunchConfirmOffBody: Members go back to their own stage or plan straight away. Nothing is deleted.
plans.tiersBody: Choose which plan each feature needs, everywhere or in specific countries. Checked on the server.

strings.title: App texts
strings.body: Change any text in the member app, per language. Changes appear on every device within a minute. Keep words like {{count}} exactly as they are.
strings.noOverrides: No changed texts yet. Search to find one.
strings.placeholders: Keep the same {{…}} placeholders as the built-in text.

support.inboxBody: Messages sent from Help and contact in the app. Replies go to the member's in-app inbox.
support.diagnosticsBody: Reports sent from Settings, Send diagnostics: permissions, sources, sync times and errors. No health values.

trials.countryBody: Welcome Unlock and trial days for new sign-ups in a country. Others use the values above.
trials.oneUserHint: To extend, reset or end one person's trial, open them in Users.
